subject: Champion handshake, MAP milestones, and EB scheduling for close plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@tesseract.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Champion handshake, MAP milestones, and EB scheduling for close plan

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I attached an updated mutual action plan (TESS_MAP_v4.xlsx) and a minimal EB availability grid (EB_availability_grid.csv). Two asks to keep momentum:

1) Executive sponsor mapping: please confirm who on your side will be the exec sponsor for the evaluation and decision (we recommended Elena Gomez). That person will be the only exec we expect at the full EB; others can join as observers.

2) EB (Executive Briefing) windows: we need three candidate 60–90 minute windows in the next 45 days so we can lock executive calendars. Our first-cut availability is in the CSV — please mark your preferred options.

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
- P0: Evaluation access provisioned (Ops + Perf) — target by 2028-03-29
- P1: Security questionnaire complete & SOC2 evidence submitted — 2028-04-05
- P2: Joint perf/latency eval + KPI review (internal) — 2028-04-12
- P3: Commercial review / SoW draft and redline — 2028-04-19
- P4: EB decision & signature — target week of 2028-04-26

If these milestones look feasible please confirm who your exec sponsor is, share preferred EB windows, and we’ll finalize the MAP and send calendar invites. I’ll loop our internal exec liaison and Karthik will run the EB.

Attachments: TESS_MAP_v4.xlsx (MAP draft), EB_availability_grid.csv

—Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@tesseract.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@tesseract.com>, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@tesseract.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Champion handshake, MAP milestones, and EB scheduling for close plan

Ben —

Thanks for the clear plan and the artifacts. Elena is confirmed as our exec sponsor for the engagement and will join the EB. Procurement is looped for the SoW work and legal/terms.

Quick notes:
- We can provision eval access to a staging cluster by 2028-03-28 (Ops team looking into IAM scoping).
- Security team asked for a short list of the SOC2 artifacts and encryption details — happy to accept a single packet of evidence rather than piecemeal. Can you send that?
- For EB windows, we prefer the week of 2028-04-16; tentative slots in the CSV: 2028-04-17 14:00–16:00 PT, 2028-04-19 09:00–11:00 PT, 2028-04-20 11:00–13:00 PT. Elena prefers afternoons.

Procurement note (Procurement <procurement@tesseract.com>): please share your standard SoW outline and any timelines around payment milestones.

Alex
Senior Director, Platform Partnerships | Tesseract Analytics
alex.rivera@tesseract.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@tesseract.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Champion handshake, MAP milestones, and EB scheduling for close plan

Ben / team —

I'll volunteer to be the Redwood exec liaison for the EB (exec sponsor on our side). High-level mapping suggestion:
- TESS exec sponsor: Elena Gomez (confirmed) <--> Redwood exec liaison: Marissa Cole
- Day-to-day evaluation owner: TESS Ops (Alex) <--> Redwood SE: Karthik Iyer
- Commercial owner: Procurement (TESS) <--> Redwood Sales: Ben Carter / Priya Natarajan

I'll prepare a one-page EB agenda and an internal pre-brief checklist. Karthik: can you confirm you can lead the product walkthrough and perf deep dive on 2028-04-17 14:00 PT (preferred by Elena)? If that slot works we should lock it now.

Also attaching a very short internal checklist for MAP handoffs (internal_only_checklist.docx) — tying owners to each milestone will help avoid single-thread risk.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@tesseract.com>, Procurement <procurement@tesseract.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-23T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Champion handshake, MAP milestones, and EB scheduling for close plan

Alex / Procurement —

Great — thanks for confirming Elena. We’ll update the MAP (attached) with owners and hard dates. Quick standouts and next steps from our side:

MAP checkpoints with owners (finalizing):
- Eval access provisioned (Ops/Engineering): target 2028-03-28 — owner: TESS Ops / Redwood SE (Karthik)
- Security artifacts packet: deliver by 2028-04-05 — owner: Redwood Security (Priya) — attaching SOC2 summary + encryption notes (Signed-SoW-draft_v2.pdf referenced inside).
- Performance checkpoints (latency, p99, throughput): run 2028-04-10 to 2028-04-12 — owner: Redwood SE + TESS Ops
- Commercial review & SoW redline: 2028-04-19 — owner: Ben / Procurement
- EB decision and signature: week of 2028-04-26 — target SLA for signature: 2028-04-28

EB scheduling: Elena preferred 2028-04-17 14:00 PT; Karthik, Marissa flagged in the note — can you confirm you can lead the walkthrough and have the test harness ready by 2028-04-10? If yes, I’ll send the calendar hold for 90 minutes for 2028-04-17 14:00–15:30 PT (we’ll leave buffer for Q&A).

Procurement: once you confirm the preferred commercial cadence, I’ll push the SoW skeleton to DocuSign. Procurement, please confirm if you need a different financial milestone cadence.

Quoted for context:
> On 2028-03-22 11:03 AM Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@tesseract.com> wrote:
> > Elena is confirmed as our exec sponsor...
> > For EB windows, we prefer the week of 2028-04-16; tentative slots in the CSV...

Attachments referenced: TESS_MAP_v4.xlsx (updated), Signed-SoW-draft_v2.pdf (SoW skeleton)

—Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@tesseract.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@tesseract.com>
Date: 2028-03-23T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Champion handshake, MAP milestones, and EB scheduling for close plan

Ben / Marissa / Alex —

Confirmed: I can lead the product walkthrough and perf deep dive on 2028-04-17 14:00 PT. Karthik will prepare:
- Live demo script (20 min) + perf replay artifacts (p99 traces, KV-cache impact)
- Short pre-reads for Elena (1 pager on latency/cost tradeoffs)
- Test harness access for TESS Ops by 2028-03-29

Procurement — for the SoW skeleton Ben referenced: procurement@tesseract.com, if you can confirm preferred payment milestones I’ll incorporate them into the commercial timeline. Otherwise I’ll default to: 30% on signature, 40% on full eval completion, 30% on production cutover.

I’ll send a calendar hold now for 2028-04-17 14:00–15:30 PT and mark it tentative until procurement confirms.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
